title: [11/01/2025] - Shalton village in 1910 and 2010
prompt: The maps below show part of a village in 1910, and the same part of that village in 2010. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The maps give information about the transformation of part of Shalton village between 1910 and 2010.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, the area underwent significant residential development over the century-long period, with a substantial increase in housing density. The most notable change was the replacement of green spaces with numerous residential buildings, while new infrastructure was also added to support the growing community.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Regarding the central triangular area bounded by High Street, School Road, and London Road, this region experienced dramatic changes from 1910 to 2010. Originally, this area contained only a few key buildings, including a large house, a grocer, and a baker, with several trees providing green space. By 2010, all the trees had been removed to make way for a dense residential neighborhood development with approximately ten houses. In addition, a new cafe had been built on the original site of commercial establishments.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: Concerning the surrounding infrastructure, several new roads were constructed to accommodate the increased residential density. A new bank was established along School Road, and a supermarket with an associated parking area was built near the school, which remained intact. Moreover, London Road and High Street saw significant residential expansion with the addition rows of houses constructed along their length. The post office situated on London Road stayed the same throughout the years.
